rca of the issue: BookingWizard.jsx references a React component `SchedulePreview` (line 114, Payment Plan step) that is neither imported nor defined in the module. In the production build the identifier resolves to `undefined`, so React throws `ReferenceError: SchedulePreview is not defined` the moment the Payment Plan step renders. The nearest error boundary swallows the subtree, leaving document.body empty. Reproduction: login admin@kkt.in, go /erp/bookings/new, pick SGH + Tower A, pick flat A-601, pick customer (any 94310xxxx), click Next on Agreement → whole page blanks and page-error fires. Fix: import or inline SchedulePreview (previously likely exported from a sibling file e.g. components/booking/SchedulePreview.jsx) and rebuild the static bundle. Add a Playwright regression that advances through Review to catch future bare-identifier regressions in the prod build.
